notes: - Relic Slot Rework to allow users to select a named relic in each slot instead of the 3 previous options.
- Relics with a Proc or Activation now enable a toggle in the Class/Spec pane to add the relic effect to the stat totals/percentages
- New UI elements to support relic rework
- Users can now overwrite an existing saved Loadout instead of having to create a new one when making changes to gear or class/spec selections.
- New UI elements to support the overwrite functionality
- Bug fixes for Database version and column errors with new changes to relic system
